clip.lead: Save any web page as a note, along with the text you have selected.
clip.step1: Drag the button to your bookmarks bar.
clip.step1Hint: If you can’t see the bar, show it with ⌘⇧B (Ctrl+Shift+B on Windows).
clip.step2: On any page, select some text and click Save to Notes.
clip.step2Hint: A small window opens with the title, link and text. Review it and save.
clip.step3: The note shows up in All notes, with a link to the source.
clip.dragOnly: Drag it to your bookmarks bar. It doesn’t clip anything here.
clip.manual: Can’t drag it? Create a new bookmark and paste this code as its address.
clip.touchInstall: Install the clipper from a computer. Copy the code to paste it there as a bookmark.
